theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The theme leads the cross-sectional momentum ranks and shows full breadth and passable durability, with the absolute-trend gate validating participation for risk control. theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Staples & Retail sits near the bottom of the momentum ranking with a mean-reverting Hurst tag, low durability (0.42), and sub-par breadth (0.231).
